findings.title: Odd-dimension padding has no regression test
findings.description: Both re-encoding commands now rely on this filter to make odd-sized recordings encodable, but no test exercises either command with odd input dimensions or verifies the produced dimensions. A filter or argument regression could therefore restore the failures this change is intended to prevent without being caught by the suite.

findings.quote:
<button class="link" onclick={async () => {
					if (isTauri()) {
						const { invoke } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/core');
						await invoke('plugin:shell|open', { path: driveLink });
					} else {
						window.open(driveLink, '_blank');
					}
				}}>{driveLink}</button>
findings.title: Drive-link opening branches have no regression tests
findings.description: The new click behavior has separate desktop and browser branches, and the desktop branch depends on the newly granted shell open permission. No test verifies that each mode opens the saved Drive URL through its intended mechanism, so a broken command, permission, or target can leave the displayed link unusable without detection.
